english: Jami, a GNU package, is software for universal and distributed peer-to-peer communication that respects the freedom and privacy of its users. Visit <jamiLink>jami.net</jamiLink> to learn more.
translation: GNU paketi bölgan Jami — qurilmalar örtasida bevosita işlaydigan universal va taqsimlangan aloqa dasturi bölib, foydalanuvçilarning erkinligi va maxfiyligini hurmat qiladi. Batafsil maʼlumot uçun <jamiLink>jami.net</jamiLink> saytiga kiring.

english: This is a list of people who have made a significant investment of time, with useful results, into Jami. Any such contributors who want to be added to the list should contact us.
translation: Bu röyxatda Jami rivojiga köp vaqt sarflagan va foydali natijalarga erişgan insonlar keltirilgan. Röyxatga qöşilişni istagan hissa qöşuvçilar biz bilan boğlanişlari mumkin.

english: This program comes with absolutely no warranty. See the <gplLink>GNU General Public License</gplLink>, version 3 or later for details.
translation: Uşbu dastur heç qanday kafolatsiz taqdim etiladi. Batafsil maʼlumot uçun <gplLink>GNU Umumiy ommaviy litsenziyasi</gplLink> (3-versiya yoki undan keyingi) matniga qarang.

english: Configuring a name server allows users to connect and find others using their usernames. Note that two users cannot have the same username on the same name server. Either keep the default Jami name server or set up your own.

english: Guest authentication enables users to access an ephemeral account. Guest login allows users to chat without requiring any information or credentials to be provided.

english: Local authentication allows users to register an account by providing a username. The account is created and managed directly by the server. If the server's data is deleted, the account and its access will be permanently lost.

translation: Uşbu hisobni guruh qönğiroqlarini ötkazadigan uçraşuv nuqtasiga aylantiriş.

english: The choice of the name Jami was inspired by the Swahili word “jamii”, which means “community” as a noun and “together” as an adverb.
translation: Jami nomi suaxili tilidagi “jamii” sözidan ilhomlanib tanlangan; u ot sifatida “jamiyat”, raviş sifatida esa “birgalikda” degan maʼnoni bildiradi.

english: What is the green dot next to my account?
A red dot means that your account is disconnected from the network; it turns green when it's connected.
translation: Qizil nuqta hisobingiz tarmoqdan uzilganini bildiradi; ulanganda u yaşil rangga özgaradi.

english: Why should I back up my account?
translation: Nega hisobimning zaxira nusxasini yaratişim kerak?

english: Jami is distributed and your account is only stored locally on your device. If you lose your password or your local account data, you WILL NOT be able to recover your account if you did not back it up earlier.
translation: Jami taqsimlangan tizim bölib, hisobingiz faqat qurilmangizda mahalliy saqlanadi. Agar parolingizni yoki mahalliy hisob maʼlumotlaringizni yöqotsangiz va avval zaxira nusxa yaratmagan bölsangiz, hisobingizni TIKLAY OLMAYSIZ.

english: Can I make a conference call?
In a call, you can click on “Invite members” to add a contact to a call.
translation: Qönğiroq paytida kontaktni qönğiroqqa qöşiş uçun “Aʼzolarni taklif qiliş” tugmasini bosişingiz mumkin.

english: A Jami account is an asymmetric encryption key. Your account is identified by a Jami ID, which is a fingerprint of your public key.
translation: Jami hisobi — bu asimmetrik şifrlaş kaliti. Hisobingiz Jami ID orqali aniqlanadi; Jami ID oçiq kalitingizning barmoq izidir.

english: What information do I need to provide to create a Jami account?
translation: Jami hisobini yaratiş uçun qanday maʼlumotlarni taqdim etişim kerak?

english: When you create a new Jami account, you do not have to provide any private information like an email, address, or phone number.
translation: Yangi Jami hisobini yaratişda elektron poçta, manzil yoki telefon raqami kabi heç qanday şaxsiy maʼlumotni taqdim etişingiz şart emas.

english: Why don’t I have to use a password?
With Jami, your account is stored in a directory on your device. The password is only used to encrypt your account in order to protect you from someone who has physical access to your device.
translation: Jami işlatganingizda hisobingiz qurilmangizdagi jildda saqlanadi. Parol faqat hisobingizni şifrlaş uçun işlatiladi — bu sizni qurilmangizga jismoniy kiriş imkoniga ega bölgan şaxslardan himoya qiladi.

english: Why don’t I have to register a username?
translation: Nega foydalanuvçi nomini röyxatdan ötkazişim şart emas?

english: The most permanent, secure identifier is your Jami ID, but since these are difficult to use for some people, you also have the option of registering a username.
translation: Eng doimiy va xavfsiz identifikator — bu sizning Jami ID; ammo baʼzi odamlar uçun undan foydalaniş qiyin bölgani sababli, foydalanuvçi nomini röyxatdan ötkaziş imkoniyati ham mavjud.

english: How can I back up my account?
In Account Settings, a button is available to create a backup of your account.
translation: Hisob sozlamalarida hisobingizning zaxira nusxasini yaratiş tugmasi mavjud.

english: What happens when I delete my account?
Your account is only stored on your own devices. If you delete your account from all of your devices, the account is gone forever and you CANNOT recover it.
translation: Hisobingiz faqat öz qurilmalaringizda saqlanadi. Agar hisobingizni barça qurilmalaringizdan öçirsangiz, u butunlay yöqoladi va uni TIKLAY OLMAYSIZ.

english: Can I use my account on multiple devices?
translation: Hisobimdan bir neçta qurilmada foydalana olamanmi?

english: Yes, you can link your account from the settings, or you can import your backup on another device.
translation: Ha, hisobingizni sozlamalar orqali boğlaşingiz yoki zaxira nusxangizni boşqa qurilmaga import qilişingiz mumkin.

translation: Foydalanuvçi nomi notöğri. Töğri foydalanuvçi nomini kiriting.
